reason: Integrates with the DeepSeek Open Platform to display account balance and estimate current-session spending from local token usage, with configurable UI refresh and pricing settings.

summaries.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Open Platform 查询账户余额，并根据当前会话的令牌用量估算消费，同时提供可配置的刷新和价格设置。
summaries.en: Queries the DeepSeek Open Platform account balance and estimates current-session spending from token usage with configurable refresh and pricing settings.

capabilities: Queries the DeepSeek account balance endpoint using the host-provided API credential
Reads session token usage from local session logs to estimate spending
Displays balance and estimated session cost in the interface
Provides configurable auto-refresh, commands, and a model tool
Persists refresh, language, and pricing settings
